offering_description.value: McCormick makes spices, seasonings and condiments for home cooks. It also develops and manufactures custom flavors and ingredients for food and beverage makers and restaurant chains.

primary_products.value: Spices and herbs; seasoning blends; sauces and condiments; flavor extracts; custom flavor systems

customer_segment.value: B2B: Grocery and mass-market retailers, food and beverage manufacturers, restaurant chains and foodservice distributors; B2C: Home cooks and other consumers buying packaged seasonings and condiments

end_markets.value: Home cooking; packaged food and beverage manufacturing; restaurants and foodservice

revenue_model.value: product sales: Packaged spices, seasonings and condiments, plus bulk and custom flavor ingredients

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Processes and blends sourced spices and other ingredients into packaged goods for retailers and foodservice buyers; component supplier: Formulates raw ingredients into flavor systems for food and beverage manufacturers and restaurant chains

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Consumer spices, seasonings and condiments alongside custom flavor systems for food manufacturing and foodservice

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: Supermarkets, mass merchandisers and warehouse clubs; direct sales: Retail accounts, food and beverage manufacturers and restaurant chains; distributors / dealers: Foodservice and ingredient distributors; online: Online retailers and company-operated brand storefronts
distribution_channels.category: third-party retail; direct sales; distributors / dealers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Food manufacturing, imports and labeling subject to FDA food safety rules and comparable rules abroad
